mkdir -p /root/nanobot-pragmata-benchmark/gallery && cp -a /root/pragmata-wallpapers/. /root/nanobot-pragmata-benchmark/gallery/ && echo "Copied OK" && ls /root/nanobot-pragmata-benchmark/gallery/ | head -20

cd /root/nanobot-pragmata-benchmark/gallery && python3 -m http.server 7788 > /tmp/gallery-server.log 2>&1 &
echo "PID=$!"
sleep 1
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:7788/

cd /root/nanobot-pragmata-benchmark/gallery && python3 -m http.server 7788 > /tmp/gallery-server.log 2>&1 &
echo "PID=$!"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:7788/ && echo " - local OK"
cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:7788 2>&1
sleep 5 && echo "waiting..."
cat /tmp/cloudflared.log 2>/dev/null || ps aux | grep cloudflared | grep -v grep
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}" https://gdp-arctic-arcade-hope.trycloudflare.com/ && echo " - public OK"
curl -v --connect-timeout 10 https://gdp-arctic-arcade-hope.trycloudflare.com/ 2>&1 | head -20

# Check if cloudflared is still running and the tunnel is registered
ps aux | grep cloudflared | grep -v grep
echo "---"
# Check server log
cat /tmp/gallery-server.log 2>/dev/null || echo "no log"
echo "---"
# Verify gallery files count
ls /root/nanobot-pragmata-benchmark/gallery/ | wc -l
echo "files in gallery"
ls /root/nanobot-pragmata-benchmark/gallery/thumbs/ | wc -l
echo "thumbs"
echo "---"
# Check ZIP exists
ls -lh /root/nanobot-pragmata-benchmark/gallery/pragmata-wallpapers.zip

curl -s -o /dev/null -w "Local: HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:7788/
# Check which tunnel URLs are currently running
ps aux | grep "cloudflared tunnel" | grep -v grep

# Get latest cloudflared output for our tunnel (port 7788 / pid 962227)
# Check if the tunnel log file exists
ls -la /tmp/cloudflared*.log 2>/dev/null
# Get the tunnel URL from cloudflared's own metrics or process
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:20241/metrics 2>/dev/null | grep -i tunnel | head -5

# Try to get the URL from cloudflared process output directly
cat /proc/962227/fd/1 2>/dev/null | tail -5 || true
cat /proc/962227/fd/2 2>/dev/null | tail -5 || true
# Try alternate approach - get URL from the metrics or cloudflared's own API
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:20241/connections 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true

# Find the log for our specific tunnel process
# Check if /tmp/cloudflared_new.log has our current tunnel URL
grep -i "trycloudflare\|your tunnel\|visit it" /tmp/cloudflared_new.log 2>/dev/null | tail -5
# Also check any recent cloudflared log files
find /tmp -name "*.log" -newer /tmp/cloudflared.log 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l "trycloudflare" 2>/dev/null | head -3
grep "trycloudflare" /tmp/cloudflared_new.log 2>/dev/null | tail -3
ls -lt /tmp/*.log 2>/dev/null | head -5

# Kill old cloudflared processes on 8080 and 8090
kill $(ps aux | grep "cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:8090" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}') 2>/dev/null && echo "killed 8090"
kill $(ps aux | grep "cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:8080" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}') 2>/dev/null && echo "killed 8080"
# Now restart our tunnel with output redirected
cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:7788 > /tmp/gallery-tunnel.log 2>&1 &
echo "new PID=$!"
sleep 6
cat /tmp/gallery-tunnel.log

echo "=== Local ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}" http://localhost:7788/ && echo ""
echo "=== Public ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}" https://directions-instructions-packs-refugees.trycloudflare.com/ && echo ""
echo "=== Gallery index ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}" https://directions-instructions-packs-refugees.trycloudflare.com/index.html && echo ""
echo "=== ZIP ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}" https://directions-instructions-packs-refugees.trycloudflare.com/pragmata-wallpapers.zip && echo ""
echo "=== File count ===" && ls /root/nanobot-pragmata-benchmark/gallery/ | wc -l

echo "=== Local gallery ===" && curl -s http://localhost:7788/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' && echo ""
echo "=== Local ZIP ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} Size: %{size_download} bytes\n" http://localhost:7788/pragmata-wallpapers.zip
echo "=== Local thumbs ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:7788/thumbs/lunar-surface-child-robot-8k.webp

ps aux | grep cloudflared | grep -v grep | grep 7788
echo "---"
# Verify tunnel health via metrics endpoint
curl -s --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:20241/metrics 2>/dev/null | grep "cloudflared_tunnel_concurrent_requests" | head -3
